data.ARTICULATION.title: data.ARTICULATION
data.ARTICULATION.description:
The following list of articulations mostly corresponds to symbols from the Western Musical
      Symbols portion of the Unicode Standard. The dot and stroke values may be used in cases where
      interpretation is difficult or undesirable.

data.AUGMENTDOT.title: data.AUGMENTDOT
data.AUGMENTDOT.description: Dots attribute values (number of augmentation dots) (Read, 113-119, ex. 8-21).

data.BARMETHOD.title: data.BARMETHOD
data.BARMETHOD.description:
Records where bar lines are drawn. The value 'staff' describes the traditional placement
      of bar lines.

data.BARRENDITION.title: data.BARRENDITION
data.BARRENDITION.description:
Renderings of bar lines. Some values correspond to the Western Musical Symbols portion of
      the Unicode Standard.

data.BEAM.title: data.BEAM
data.BEAM.description: Beam attribute values: initial, medial, terminal. Nested beaming is permitted.

data.BEAMPLACE.title: data.BEAMPLACE
data.BEAMPLACE.description: Location of a beam relative to the events it affects.

data.BEAT.title: data.BEAT
data.BEAT.description: A beat location, [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <abbr> tag: {"type":"element","name":"abbr","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"i.e."}]}]], a decimal number.

data.BEATRPT.REND.title: data.BEATRPT.REND
data.BEATRPT.REND.description: Visual and performance information for a repeated beat symbol.

data.BEND.AMOUNT.title: data.BEND.AMOUNT
data.BEND.AMOUNT.description:
Either an integer value, a decimal value, or a token. Fractional values are limited to
      .25, .5, .75, while the token value is restricted to 'full'.

data.CANCELACCID.title: data.CANCELACCID
data.CANCELACCID.description: Indicates where cancellation accidentals are shown in a key signature.

data.CERTAINTY.title: data.CERTAINTY
data.CERTAINTY.description:
Values for certainty attribute. Certainty may be expressed by one of the predefined symbolic values [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <val> tag: {"type":"element","name":"val","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"high"}]}]], 
      [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <val> tag: {"type":"element","name":"val","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"medium"}]}]], or [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <val> tag: {"type":"element","name":"val","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"low"}]}]]. The value [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <val> tag: {"type":"element","name":"val","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"unknown"}]}]] should be used in cases where the encoder 
      does not wish to assert an opinion about the matter.

data.CLEFLINE.title: data.CLEFLINE
data.CLEFLINE.description:
Clef line attribute values. The value must be in the range between 1 and the number of
      lines on the staff. The numbering of lines starts with the lowest line of the staff.

data.CLEFSHAPE.title: data.CLEFSHAPE
data.CLEFSHAPE.description:
Clef shape attribute values (Read, p.53-56). Some values correspond to the Unicode
      Standard.

data.CONFIDENCE.title: data.CONFIDENCE
data.CONFIDENCE.description:
Confidence is expressed as a real number between 0 and 1; 0 representing certainly false
      and 1 representing certainly true.

data.COLORNAMES.title: data.COLORNAMES
data.COLORNAMES.description: List of named colors from CSS Color Module Level 4.

data.COLOR.title: data.COLOR
data.COLOR.description:
A value in one of the following forms is expected: 1) hexadecimal RRGGBB, 2) hexadecimal
      RRGGBBAA, 3) CSS RGB, 4) CSS RGBA, 5) HSL, 6) HSLA, or 7) CSS color name.

data.COMPASSDIRECTION.title: data.COMPASSDIRECTION
data.COMPASSDIRECTION.description: Description of direction with respect to an imaginary compass.

data.DEGREES.title: data.DEGREES
data.DEGREES.description:
360th-unit measure of a circle’s circumference; optionally signed decimal number between
      -360 and 360.

data.DURATION.title: data.DURATION
data.DURATION.description: Logical, that is, written, duration attribute values.

data.DURATIONRESTS.title: data.DURATIONRESTS
data.DURATIONRESTS.description: Logical, that is, written, duration attribute values for rests.

data.ENCLOSURE.title: data.ENCLOSURE
data.ENCLOSURE.description: Enclosures for editorial notes, accidentals, articulations, etc.

data.EVENTREL.title: data.EVENTREL
data.EVENTREL.description: Location of musical material relative to a symbol on a staff instead of the staff.

data.EVENTREL.basic.title: data.EVENTREL.basic
data.EVENTREL.basic.description: Location of musical material relative to a symbol other than a staff.

data.EVENTREL.extended.title: data.EVENTREL.extended
data.EVENTREL.extended.description: Location of musical material relative to a symbol other than a staff.

data.FILL.title: data.FILL
data.FILL.description:
Describes how a graphical object, such as a note head, should be filled. The relative
      values — top, bottom, left, and right — indicate these locations *after* rotation is
      applied.

data.FINGER.FRET.title: data.FINGER.FRET
data.FINGER.FRET.description:
In a guitar chord diagram, a label indicating which finger, if any, should be used to play
      an individual string. The index, middle, ring, and little fingers are represented by the
      values 1-4, while 't' is for the thumb. The values 'x' and 'o' indicate stopped and open
      strings, respectively.

data.FONTSIZENUMERIC.title: data.FONTSIZENUMERIC
data.FONTSIZENUMERIC.description: Font size expressed as numbers; [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <abbr> tag: {"type":"element","name":"abbr","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"i.e."}]}]], points or virtual units.

data.FONTSIZESCALE.title: data.FONTSIZESCALE
data.FONTSIZESCALE.description: Relative size of symbol that may begin/end a line.

data.FONTSIZETERM.title: data.FONTSIZETERM
data.FONTSIZETERM.description: Font size expressed as relative term.

data.FRETNUMBER.title: data.FRETNUMBER
data.FRETNUMBER.description:
In string tablature, the fret number. The value [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <val> tag: {"type":"element","name":"val","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"0"}]}]] (zero) indicates the open
      string.

data.GRACE.title: data.GRACE
data.GRACE.description: Do grace notes get time from the current (acc) or previous (unacc) one?

data.HORIZONTALALIGNMENT.title: data.HORIZONTALALIGNMENT
data.HORIZONTALALIGNMENT.description: Data values for attributes that capture horizontal alignment.

data.INTERVAL.HARMONIC.title: data.INTERVAL.HARMONIC
data.INTERVAL.HARMONIC.description: A token indicating diatonic interval quality and size in shorthand notation.

data.INTERVAL.MELODIC.title: data.INTERVAL.MELODIC
data.INTERVAL.MELODIC.description:
A token indicating direction of the interval but not its precise value, a diatonic
      interval (with optional direction and quality), or a decimal value in half steps. Decimal
      values are permitted to accommodate micro-tuning.

data.ISOTIME.title: data.ISOTIME
data.ISOTIME.description:
ISO 24-hour time format: HH:MM:SS.ss, [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <abbr> tag: {"type":"element","name":"abbr","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"i.e."}]}]],
      [0-9][0-9]:[0-9][0-9]:[0-9][0-9](\.?[0-9]*)?.

data.KEYFIFTHS.title: data.KEYFIFTHS
data.KEYFIFTHS.description: Indicates the location of the tonic in the circle of fifths.

data.LAYERSCHEME.title: data.LAYERSCHEME
data.LAYERSCHEME.description:
Indicates how stems should be drawn when more than one layer is present and stem
      directions are not indicated on the notes/chords themselves. '1' indicates that there is only
      a single layer on a staff. '2o' means there are two layers with opposing stems. '2f' indicates
      two 'free' layers; that is, opposing stems will be drawn unless one of the layers has 'space'.
      In that case, stem direction in the remaining layer will be determined as if there were only
      one layer. '3o' and '3f' are analogous to '2o' and '2f' with three layers allowed.

data.LINESTARTENDSYMBOL.title: data.LINESTARTENDSYMBOL
data.LINESTARTENDSYMBOL.description: Symbol that may begin/end a line.

data.MEASUREBEAT.title: data.MEASUREBEAT
data.MEASUREBEAT.description:
A count of measures plus a beat location, [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <abbr> tag: {"type":"element","name":"abbr","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"i.e."}]}]], [0-9]+m *\+ *[0-9]+(\.?[0-9]*)?. The
      measure count is the number of bar lines crossed by the event, while the beat location is a
      timestamp expressed as a beat with an optional fractional part. For example, "1m+3.5"
      indicates a point in the next measure on the second half of beat 3. The measure number must be
      in the range of 0 to the number of remaining measures, while the beat number must be in the
      range from 0 to the numerator of the time signature plus 1. For example, in 6/8 the beat
      number must be within the range from 0 (the left bar line) to 7 (the right bar line). A value
      with a measure number of "0", such as "0m+2", indicates a point within the current
      measure.

data.MEASUREBEATOFFSET.title: data.MEASUREBEATOFFSET
data.MEASUREBEATOFFSET.description:
A count of measures plus a beat location, [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <abbr> tag: {"type":"element","name":"abbr","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"i.e."}]}]], (\+|-)?[0-9]+m\+[0-9]+(\.?[0-9]*)?. The
      measure count is the number of bar lines crossed by the event, while the beat location is a
      timestamp expressed as a beat with an optional fractional part. The measure number must be in
      the range of preceding measures to the number of remaining measures. A value with a positive
      measure number, such as "1m+3", indicates a point in the following measure, while a value with
      a negative measure number, such as "-1m+3", marks a point in the preceding measure. The beat
      number must be in the range from 0 to the numerator of the time signature plus 1. For example,
      in 6/8 the beat number must be within the range from 0 (the left bar line) to 7 (the right
      bar line). A value with a measure number of "0", such as "0m+2", indicates a point within the
      current measure.

data.MEASUREMENTUNSIGNED.title: data.MEASUREMENTUNSIGNED
data.MEASUREMENTUNSIGNED.description:
Measurement expressed in real-world ([[ERROR: Cannot process text with <abbr> tag: {"type":"element","name":"abbr","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"e.g."}]}]], centimeters, millimeters, inches, points,
      picas, or pixels) or virtual units (vu). 'vu' is the default value. Unlike
      data.MEASUREMENTSIGNED, only positive values are allowed.

data.MEASUREMENTSIGNED.title: data.MEASUREMENTSIGNED
data.MEASUREMENTSIGNED.description:
Measurement expressed in real-world ([[ERROR: Cannot process text with <abbr> tag: {"type":"element","name":"abbr","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"e.g."}]}]], centimeters, millimeters, inches, points,
      picas, or pixels) or virtual units (vu). 'vu' is the default value. Unlike
      data.MEASUREMENTUNSIGNED, in which only positive values are allowed, both positive and negative
      values are permitted.

data.MEASUREMENTFONTUNSIGNED.title: data.MEASUREMENTFONTUNSIGNED
data.MEASUREMENTFONTUNSIGNED.description:
Measurement expressed relative to properties of the current font, in analogy to the
      respective CSS length units. Unlike data.MEASUREMENTFONTUNSIGNED, only positive values are
      allowed.

data.MEASUREMENTFONTSIGNED.title: data.MEASUREMENTFONTSIGNED
data.MEASUREMENTFONTSIGNED.description:
Measurement expressed relative to properties of the current font, in analogy to the
      respective CSS length units. Unlike data.MEASUREMENTFONTUNSIGNED, both positive and negative values
      are allowed.

data.MEASUREMENTTYPOGRAPHYUNSIGNED.title: data.MEASUREMENTTYPOGRAPHYUNSIGNED
data.MEASUREMENTTYPOGRAPHYUNSIGNED.description:
Measurements used for typographical features. Unlike data.MEASUREMENTTYPOGRAPHYSIGNED, only
      positive values are allowed.

data.MEASUREMENTTYPOGRAPHYSIGNED.title: data.MEASUREMENTTYPOGRAPHYSIGNED
data.MEASUREMENTTYPOGRAPHYSIGNED.description:
Measurements used for typographical features. Unlike data.MEASUREMENTTYPOGRAPHYSIGNED, both
      positive and negative values are allowed.

data.MELODICFUNCTION.title: data.MELODICFUNCTION
data.MELODICFUNCTION.description:
Indication of melodic function, [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <abbr> tag: {"type":"element","name":"abbr","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"i.e."}]}]], anticipation, lower neighbor, escape tone,
      etc.

data.METERFORM.title: data.METERFORM
data.METERFORM.description: Contains an indication of how a meter signature should be rendered.

data.MIDICHANNEL.title: data.MIDICHANNEL
data.MIDICHANNEL.description: MIDI channel number. One-based values must be followed by a lower-case letter "o".

data.MIDIBPM.title: data.MIDIBPM
data.MIDIBPM.description:
Tempo expressed as "beats" per minute, where "beat" is always defined as a quarter note,
      *not the numerator of the time signature or the metronomic indication*.

data.MIDIMSPB.title: data.MIDIMSPB
data.MIDIMSPB.description:
Tempo expressed as microseconds per "beat", where "beat" is always defined as a quarter
      note, *not the numerator of the time signature or the metronomic indication*.

data.MIDIVALUE.title: data.MIDIVALUE
data.MIDIVALUE.description: Generic MIDI value. One-based values must be followed by a lower-case letter "o".

data.MODSRELATIONSHIP.title: data.MODSRELATIONSHIP
data.MODSRELATIONSHIP.description: Bibliographic relationship values based on MODS version 3.4.

data.NCNAME.title: data.NCNAME
data.NCNAME.description:
"Convenience" datatype that permits combining enumerated values with a user-supplied
      name.

data.NMTOKEN.title: data.NMTOKEN
data.NMTOKEN.description:
"Convenience" datatype that permits combining enumerated values with user-supplied
      values.

data.NOTEHEADMODIFIER.title: data.NOTEHEADMODIFIER
data.NOTEHEADMODIFIER.description:
Captures any notehead "modifiers"; that is, symbols added to the notehead, such as
      slashes, lines, text, and enclosures, etc.

data.NOTEHEADMODIFIER.pat.title: data.NOTEHEADMODIFIER.pat
data.NOTEHEADMODIFIER.pat.description: Captures text rendered in the center of the notehead.

data.OCTAVE.title: data.OCTAVE
data.OCTAVE.description: Octave number. The default values conform to the Scientific Pitch Notation (SPN).

data.OCTAVE.DIS.title: data.OCTAVE.DIS
data.OCTAVE.DIS.description:
The amount of octave displacement; that is, '8' (as in '8va' for 1 octave), '15' (for 2
      octaves), or rarely '22' (for 3 octaves).

data.ORIENTATION.title: data.ORIENTATION
data.ORIENTATION.description: Rotation or reflection of base symbol values.

data.NEIGHBORINGLAYER.title: data.NEIGHBORINGLAYER
data.NEIGHBORINGLAYER.description:
For musical material designated to appear on an adjacent layer or staff, the location of the layer
      relative to the current one; [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <abbr> tag: {"type":"element","name":"abbr","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"i.e."}]}]], the layer above or the layer below.

data.PAGE.PANELS.title: data.PAGE.PANELS
data.PAGE.PANELS.description: The number of panels per page.

data.PERCENT.title: data.PERCENT
data.PERCENT.description: Positive decimal number plus '%', [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <abbr> tag: {"type":"element","name":"abbr","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"i.e."}]}]], [0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?%.

data.PERCENT.LIMITED.title: data.PERCENT.LIMITED
data.PERCENT.LIMITED.description: Decimal number between 0 and 100, followed by a percent sign "%".

data.PERCENT.LIMITED.SIGNED.title: data.PERCENT.LIMITED.SIGNED
data.PERCENT.LIMITED.SIGNED.description: Decimal number between -100 and 100, followed by a percent sign "%".

data.PGFUNC.title: data.PGFUNC
data.PGFUNC.description: Page header and footer function; a value that defines the function (i.e., the placement) of the header or the footer.

data.PGSCALE.title: data.PGSCALE
data.PGSCALE.description: Page scale factor; a percentage of the values in page.height and page.width.

data.PITCHNAME.title: data.PITCHNAME
data.PITCHNAME.description:
The pitch names (gamut) used within a single octave. The default values conform to
      Acoustical Society of America representation.

data.PITCHNAME.GESTURAL.title: data.PITCHNAME.GESTURAL
data.PITCHNAME.GESTURAL.description:
Gestural pitch names need an additional value for when the notated pitch is not to be
      sounded.

data.PITCHNUMBER.title: data.PITCHNUMBER
data.PITCHNUMBER.description: Pnum (pitch number, [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <abbr> tag: {"type":"element","name":"abbr","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"e.g."}]}]], MIDI) attribute values.

data.SLASH.title: data.SLASH
data.SLASH.description: The number of slashes to be rendered for tremolandi.

data.SLUR.title: data.SLUR
data.SLUR.description:
i=initial, m=medial, t=terminal. Number is used to match endpoints of the slur when slurs
      are nested or overlap.

data.STAFFITEM.title: data.STAFFITEM
data.STAFFITEM.description: Items that may be printed above, below, or between staves.

data.STAFFITEM.basic.title: data.STAFFITEM.basic
data.STAFFITEM.basic.description: Items in all repertoires that may be printed near a staff.

data.STAFFLOC.title: data.STAFFLOC
data.STAFFLOC.description:
Staff location. The value [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <val> tag: {"type":"element","name":"val","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"0"}]}]] indicates the bottom line of the current staff; positive
      values are used for positions above the bottom line and negative values for the positions

      on.

data.STAFFREL.title: data.STAFFREL
data.STAFFREL.description: Location of musical material relative to a staff.

data.STAFFREL.basic.title: data.STAFFREL.basic
data.STAFFREL.basic.description: Location of symbol relative to a staff.

data.STAFFREL.extended.title: data.STAFFREL.extended
data.STAFFREL.extended.description: Location of symbol relative to a staff.

data.STEMPOSITION.title: data.STEMPOSITION
data.STEMPOSITION.description: Position of a note’s stem relative to the head of the note.

data.STRINGNUMBER.title: data.STRINGNUMBER
data.STRINGNUMBER.description: This datatype is deprecated in favor of data.COURSENUMBER and will be removed in a future version. In string tablature, the number of the string to be played.

data.TEMPOVALUE.title: data.TEMPOVALUE
data.TEMPOVALUE.description: Beats (meter signature denominator) per minute, [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <abbr> tag: {"type":"element","name":"abbr","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"e.g."}]}]], 120.

data.TEXTRENDITIONLIST.title: data.TEXTRENDITIONLIST
data.TEXTRENDITIONLIST.description: Closed list of text rendition values.

data.TIE.title: data.TIE
data.TIE.description: Tie attribute values: initial, medial, terminal.

data.TSTAMPOFFSET.title: data.TSTAMPOFFSET
data.TSTAMPOFFSET.description:
A positive or negative offset from the value given in the tstamp attribute in terms of
      musical time, [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <abbr> tag: {"type":"element","name":"abbr","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"i.e."}]}]], beats[.fractional beat part].

data.TUPLET.title: data.TUPLET
data.TUPLET.description: Tuplet attribute values: initial, medial, terminal.

data.VERTICALALIGNMENT.title: data.VERTICALALIGNMENT
data.VERTICALALIGNMENT.description: Data values for attributes that capture vertical alignment.

data.WORD.title: data.WORD
data.WORD.description:
A single "word" that contains only letters, digits, punctuation characters, or symbols. It
      cannot contain whitespace.

notationtype.title: notationtype
notationtype.description:
Contains classification of the notation contained or described by the element bearing
          this attribute.
notationtype.name: attDef

notationsubtype.title: notationsubtype
notationsubtype.description:
Provides any sub-classification of the notation contained or described by the element,
          additional to that given by its notationtype attribute.
notationsubtype.name: attDef

An element with a notationsubtype attribute must have
                a notationtype attribute.

att.notationType.title: att.notationType
att.notationType.description: Attributes that provide for classification of notation.

form.title: form
form.description: Indicates to what degree the harmonic label is supported by the notation.
form.name: attDef

, the
              notes "D F♯ A" for the harmonic label "D".

The harmonic label relies on notes implied, but not actually present, in the
              notation,

, the notes "D F♯ C" for the harmonic label "D7". The note "A" is
              missing from the notation, but can be implied.

deg.title: degree
deg.description:
Captures scale degree information using [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <ref> tag: {"type":"element","name":"ref","attributes":{"target":"https://www.humdrum.org/rep/deg/"},"elements":[{"type":"text","text":"Humdrum **deg syntax"}]}]] -- an optional indicator
          of melodic approach (^ = ascending approach, v = descending approach), a scale degree
          value (1 = tonic ... 7 = leading tone), and an optional indication of chromatic
          alteration, [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <val> tag: {"type":"element","name":"val","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"1"}]}]], [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <val> tag: {"type":"element","name":"val","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"v7"}]}]], [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <val> tag: {"type":"element","name":"val","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"^1"}]}]], or [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <val> tag: {"type":"element","name":"val","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"v5+"}]}]], for example. 
          The amount of chromatic alternation is not indicated.
deg.name: attDef

att.harmonicFunction.title: att.harmonicFunction
att.harmonicFunction.description: Attributes describing the harmonic function of a single pitch.

inth.title: interval harmonic
inth.description: Encodes the harmonic interval between pitches occurring at the same time.
inth.name: attDef

intm.title: interval melodic
intm.description:
Encodes the melodic interval from the previous pitch. The value may be a general
          directional indication (u, d, s, etc.), an indication of diatonic interval direction,
          quality, and size, or a precise numeric value in half steps.
intm.name: attDef

att.intervalMelodic.title: att.intervalMelodic
att.intervalMelodic.description: Attributes that provide for description of intervallic content.

key.accid.title: key.accid
key.accid.description:
Contains an accidental for the tonic key, if one is required, [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <abbr> tag: {"type":"element","name":"abbr","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"e.g."}]}]], if [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <att> tag: {"type":"element","name":"att","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"key.pname"}]}]]

key.pname.name: attDef

att.keySigDefault.anl.title: att.keySigDefault.anl
att.keySigDefault.anl.description:
Used by staffDef and scoreDef to provide default values for attributes in the analytical
      domain that are related to key signatures.

mfunc.title: mfunc
mfunc.description: Describes melodic function using [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <ref> tag: {"type":"element","name":"ref","attributes":{"target":"https://www.humdrum.org/rep/embel/"},"elements":[{"type":"text","text":"Humdrum **embel syntax"}]}]].

att.mRest.anl.title: att.mRest.anl
att.mRest.anl.description: Analytical domain attributes in the CMN repertoire.

att.mSpace.anl.title: att.mSpace.anl

      encode this measure’s position in a string of measures containing only [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <gi> tag: {"type":"element","name":"gi","attributes":{"scheme":"MEI"},"elements":[{"type":"text","text":"mRest"}]}]] elements.

att.plica.anl.title: att.plica.anl
att.plica.anl.description: Analytical domain attributes that describe the properties of a plica in the mensural repertoire.

psolfa.name: attDef

att.solfa.title: att.solfa
att.solfa.description: Attributes that specify pitch using sol-fa.

att.stem.anl.title: att.stem.anl
att.stem.anl.description: Analytical domain attributes that describe the properties of a stem in the mensural repertoire.

data.DURATION.cmn.title: data.DURATION.cmn
data.DURATION.cmn.description: Logical, that is, written, duration attribute values for the CMN repertoire.

data.HARPPEDALPOSITION.title: data.HARPPEDALPOSITION
data.HARPPEDALPOSITION.description: Indicates the pedal setting for a harp strings.

data.STAFFITEM.cmn.title: data.STAFFITEM.cmn
data.STAFFITEM.cmn.description: Items in the CMN repertoire that may be printed near a staff.

order.title: order
order.description: Describes the direction in which an arpeggio is to be performed.
order.name: attDef

elements.text:
Non-arpeggiated style (usually rendered with a preceding bracket instead of a wavy
              line).

beam.with.title: beam.with
beam.with.description:
In the case of cross-staff beams, the beam.with attribute is used to indicate which
          staff the beam is connected to; that is, the staff above or the staff below.
beam.with.name: attDef

beam.group.title: beam.group
beam.group.description:
Provides an example of how automated beaming (including secondary beams) is to be
          performed.
beam.group.name: attDef

beam.rests.title: beam.rests

Indicates whether automatically-drawn beams should include rests shorter than a

elements.text:
The sustain pedal, also referred to as the "damper" pedal, allows the piano
              strings to vibrate sympathetically with the struck strings. It is the right-most and
              the most frequently used pedal on modern pianos.

The soft pedal, sometimes called the "una corda", "piano", or "half-blow" pedal,
              reduces the volume and modifies the timbre of the piano. On the modern piano, it is
              the left-most pedal.

The sostenuto or tone-sustaining pedal allows notes already undamped to continue
              to ring while other notes are damped normally; that is, on their release by the
              fingers. This is usually the center pedal of the modern piano.

The silent or practice pedal mutes the volume of the piano so that one may
              practice quietly. It is sometimes a replacement for the sostenuto pedal, especially on
              an upright or vertical instrument.

num.title: number
num.description: MIDI number in the range set by data.MIDIVALUE.
num.name: attDef

midi.bpm.title: midi.bpm
midi.bpm.description:
Captures the number of *quarter notes* per minute. In MIDI, a beat is always defined
          as a quarter note, *not the numerator of the time signature or the metronomic
          indication*.
midi.bpm.name: attDef

midi.mspb.title: midi.mspb
midi.mspb.description:
Records the number of microseconds per *quarter note*. In MIDI, a beat is always
          defined as a quarter note, *not the numerator of the time signature or the metronomic
          indication*. At 120 quarter notes per minute, each quarter note will last 500,000
          microseconds.
midi.mspb.name: attDef

att.midiTempo.title: att.midiTempo
att.midiTempo.description: Attributes that record MIDI tempo information.

att.midiValue2.title: att.midiValue2
att.midiValue2.description: Attributes that record terminal MIDI values.

att.midiVelocity.title: att.midiVelocity
att.midiVelocity.description: MIDI attributes pertaining to key velocity.

ppq.title: ppq
ppq.description:
Indicates the number of pulses (sometimes referred to as ticks or divisions) per
          quarter note. Unlike MIDI, MEI permits different values for a score and individual
          staves.
ppq.name: attDef

model.midiLike.title: model.midiLike
model.midiLike.description: Groups elements which group MIDI-like elements.

num.title: num
num.description: MIDI number in the range set by data.MIDICHANNEL.
num.name: attDef

hex.title: hex
hex.description: Arbitrary MIDI data in hexadecimal form.

midi.title: midi
midi.description: Container for elements that contain information useful when generating MIDI output.

form.title: form
form.description: Indicates whether this is note-on or note-off velocity data.
form.name: attDef

elements.text: The comptype attribute may occur on

                componentList.

              the binding process.

att.componentType.title: att.componentType
att.componentType.description: Attributes that express the relationship between a component and its host.

scheme.title: scheme
scheme.description:
Identifies the foliation scheme in terms of which the location is being specified by
          pointing to some foliation element defining it, or to some other equivalent
          resource.
scheme.name: attDef

model.msInline.title: model.msInline
model.msInline.description: Groups elements that may appear inline when the msdesc module is active.

accMat.title: accMat
accMat.description:
Holds a description of any additional material bound with an item, such as
      non-contemporaneous documents or fragments.

addDesc.title: addition description
addDesc.description:
Provides a description of significant additions found within an
      item, such as marginalia or other annotations.

binding.title: binding
binding.description:
Contains a description of one binding, [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <abbr> tag: {"type":"element","name":"abbr","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"i.e."}]}]], type of covering, boards, etc.
      applied to an item.

bindingDesc.title: binding description
bindingDesc.description: Describes the present and former bindings of an item.

catchwords.title: catchwords
catchwords.description:
Describes the system used to ensure correct ordering of the quires making up an item,
      typically by means of annotations at the foot of the page.

collation.title: collation
collation.description:
Records a description of how the leaves or bifolia of an item are physically
      arranged.

colophon.title: colophon
colophon.description:
Contains a statement providing information regarding the date, place, agency, or reason
      for production of the item.

decoDesc.title: decoration description
decoDesc.description: Contains a description of the decoration of an item.

decoNote.title: decoration note
decoNote.description:
Contains a description of one or more decorative features of an
      item.

explicit.title: explicit
explicit.description:
Contains the explicit of a manuscript item; that is, the closing words of the text proper,
      exclusive of any rubric or colophon which might follow it.

foliation.title: foliation
foliation.description:
Describes the numbering system or systems used to count the leaves or pages in a
      codex.

heraldry.title: heraldry
heraldry.description:
Contains a heraldic formula or phrase, typically found as part of a blazon, coat of arms,
      etc.

cols.title: cols
cols.description: Specifies the number of columns per page.
cols.name: attDef

ruledlines.title: ruledlines
ruledlines.description: Specifies the number of ruled text lines per column.
ruledlines.name: attDef

writtenlines.title: writtenlines
writtenlines.description: Specifies the number of written text lines per column.
writtenlines.name: attDef

ruledstaves.title: ruledstaves
ruledstaves.description: Specifies the number of ruled staves per column.
ruledstaves.name: attDef

writtenstaves.title: writtenstaves
writtenstaves.description: Specifies the number of written staves per column.
writtenstaves.name: attDef

layout.title: layout
layout.description:
Describes how text is laid out on the page, including information about any ruling,
      pricking, or other evidence of page-preparation techniques.

from.title: from
from.description: Specifies the starting point of the location in a normalized form.
from.name: attDef

to.title: to
to.description: Specifies the end-point of the location in a normalized form.
to.name: attDef

locus.title: locus
locus.description:
Defines a location within a manuscript or manuscript component, usually as a (possibly
      discontinuous) sequence of folio references.

locusGrp.title: locus group
locusGrp.description:
Groups locations which together form a distinct but discontinuous item
      within a manuscript or manuscript part, according to a specific foliation.

elements.text: Signals beginning of a text division.
Marks the end of a text division.

rubric.title: rubric
rubric.description:
Contains a string of words through which a manuscript signals the beginning or end of a
      text division, often with an assertion as to its author and title, which is in some way set
      off from the text itself, usually in red ink, or by use of different size or type of script,
      or some other such visual device.

scriptDesc.title: script description
scriptDesc.description:
Contains a description of the letters or characters used in an
      autographic item.

scriptNote.title: script note
scriptNote.description:
Describes a particular script distinguished within the description of an
      autographic item.

seal.title: seal
seal.description: A single seal or similar attachment.

sealDesc.title: seal description
sealDesc.description:
Describes the seals or similar external attachments applied to an
      item.

secFolio.title: second folio
secFolio.description:
Marks the word or words taken from a fixed point in a codex (typically
      the beginning of the second leaf) in order to provide a unique identifier for the item.

signatures.title: signatures
signatures.description: Provides a description of the leaf or quire signatures found within a codex.

stamp.title: stamp
stamp.description:
Contains a word or phrase describing an official mark indicating ownership, genuineness,
      validity, etc.

support.title: support
support.description: Provides a description of the physical support material of a written item.

material.title: material
material.description:
Short, project-defined name for the material composing the majority of the
          support.
material.name: attDef

supportDesc.title: support description
supportDesc.description:
Groups elements describing the physical support material of an
      item.

typeDesc.title: type description
typeDesc.description:
Contains a description of the typefaces or other aspects of the
      printing of a printed source.

typeNote.title: type note
typeNote.description:
Describes a particular font or other significant typographic feature of a
      printed resource.

model.addressPart.title: model.addressPart
model.addressPart.description: Groups elements used as part of a physical address.

model.geogNamePart.title: model.geogNamePart
model.geogNamePart.description: Groups elements which form part of a geographic name.

model.nameLike.agent.title: model.nameLike.agent
model.nameLike.agent.description: Groups elements which contain names of individuals or corporate bodies.

model.nameLike.label.title: model.nameLike.label
model.nameLike.label.description: Groups elements that serve as stylistic labels.

model.persNamePart.title: model.persNamePart
model.persNamePart.description: Groups elements which form part of a personal name.

addName.title: additional name
addName.description:
Contains an additional name component, such as a nickname, epithet, or
      alias, or any other descriptive phrase used within a personal name.

bloc.title: bloc
bloc.description:
Contains the name of a geopolitical unit consisting of two or more nation states or
      countries.

corpName.title: corporate name
corpName.description:
Identifies an organization or group of people that acts as a single
      entity.

country.title: country
country.description:
Contains the name of a geopolitical unit, such as a nation, country, colony, or
      commonwealth, larger than or administratively superior to a region and smaller than a
      bloc.

district.title: district
district.description:
Contains the name of any kind of subdivision of a settlement, such as a parish, ward, or
      other administrative or geographic unit.

famName.title: family name
famName.description:
Contains a family (inherited) name, as opposed to a given, baptismal, or
      nick name.

foreName.title: foreName
foreName.description: Contains a forename, given or baptismal name.

genName.title: generational name component
genName.description:
Contains a name component used to distinguish otherwise
      similar names on the basis of the relative ages or generations of the persons named.

geogFeat.title: geographical feature name
geogFeat.description:
Contains a common noun identifying a geographical
      feature.

geogName.title: geographic name
geogName.description:
The proper noun designation for a place, natural feature, or political
      jurisdiction.

nameLink.title: name link
nameLink.description:
Contains a connecting phrase or link used within a name but not regarded as
      part of it, such as "van der" or "of", "from", etc.

periodName.title: period name
periodName.description:
A label that describes a period of time, such as 'Baroque' or '3rd Style
      period'.

persName.title: personal name
persName.description:
Designation for an individual, including any or all of that individual's
      forenames, surnames, honorific titles, and added names.

postBox.title: postal box or post office box
postBox.description:
Contains a number or other identifier for some postal
      delivery point other than a street address.

postCode.title: postal code
postCode.description:
Contains a numerical or alphanumeric code used as part of a postal address
      to simplify sorting or delivery of mail.

region.title: region
region.description:
Contains the name of an administrative unit such as a state, province, or county, larger
      than a settlement, but smaller than a country.

roleName.title: role name
roleName.description:
Contains a name component which indicates that the referent has a particular
      role or position in society, such as an official title or rank.

settlement.title: settlement
settlement.description:
Contains the name of a settlement such as a city, town, or village identified as a single
      geopolitical or administrative unit.

street.title: street
street.description:
full street address including any name or number identifying a building as well as the
      name of the street or route on which it is located.

styleName.title: style name
styleName.description:
A label for a characteristic style of writing or performance, such as
      'bebop' or 'rock-n-roll'.

data.STAFFITEM.neumes.title: data.STAFFITEM.neumes
data.STAFFITEM.neumes.description: Items in the Neume repertoire that may be printed near a staff.

form.title: form
form.description: Identifies the different kinds of division.
form.name: attDef

con.title: con
con.description:
Connection to the previous component within the same neume; this attribute should not
          be used for the first component of a neume.
con.name: attDef

hooked.title: hooked
hooked.description: Pen stroke has an extension; specific to Hispanic notation.
hooked.name: attDef

rellen.title: rellen
rellen.description:
Length of the pen stroke relative to the previous component within the same neume;
          this attribute should not be used for the first component of a neume.
rellen.name: attDef

s-shape.title: s-shape
s-shape.description:
Direction of the initial direction for an s-shaped pen stroke; [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <abbr> tag: {"type":"element","name":"abbr","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"i.e."}]}]], "w" for the
          standard letter S, "e" for its mirror image, "s" for the letter S turned 90-degrees
          anti-clockwise, and "n" for its mirror image.
s-shape.name: attDef

att.ncForm.title: att.ncForm
att.ncForm.description: Attributes that record visual details of neume notation.

type.title: type
type.description:
Designation which characterizes the element in some sense, using any convenient
          classification scheme or typology that employs single-token labels.
type.name: attDef

att.neumeType.title: att.neumeType
att.neumeType.description: Attributes that specify the type of neumes.

model.eventLike.neumes.title: model.eventLike.neumes
model.eventLike.neumes.description: Groups event elements that occur in the neume repertoire.

model.layerPart.neumes.title: model.layerPart.neumes
model.layerPart.neumes.description: Groups notated events that may appear at the layer level in the neume repertoire.

model.neumeComponentModifierLike.title: model.neumeComponentModifierLike
model.neumeComponentModifierLike.description: Groups elements that modify neume components.

model.neumeModifierLike.title: model.neumeModifierLike
model.neumeModifierLike.description: Groups elements that modify neume-like features.

model.neumePart.title: model.neumePart
model.neumePart.description: Groups elements that may occur within a neume.

model.syllableLike.title: model.syllableLike
model.syllableLike.description: Groups elements that accommodate neumed text.

model.syllablePart.title: model.syllablePart
model.syllablePart.description: Groups elements that may appear as part of the content of a syllable.

nc.title: nc
nc.description:
Sign representing a single pitched event, although the exact pitch may not be
      known.

ncGrp.title: neume component group
ncGrp.description: Collection of one or more neume components.

neume.title: neume
neume.description: Sign representing one or more musical pitches.

syllable.title: syllable
syllable.description:
Neume notation can be thought of as "neumed text". Therefore, the syllable element
      provides high-level organization in this repertoire.

divLine.title: divLine
divLine.description:
Represents a division (divisio) in neume notation. Divisions indicate short, medium, or long pauses
    similar to breath marks in modern notation.

when.title: when
when.description:
Indicates the point of occurrence of this feature along a time line. Its value must be
          the ID of a [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <gi> tag: {"type":"element","name":"gi","attributes":{"scheme":"MEI"},"elements":[{"type":"text","text":"when"}]}]] element elsewhere in the document.
when.name: attDef

avFile.title: audio/video file
avFile.description: References an external digital audio or video file.

clip.title: clip
clip.description:
Defines a time segment of interest within a recording or within a digital audio or video
      file.

performance.title: performance
performance.description: A presentation of one or more musical works.

absolute.title: absolute
absolute.description: Provides an absolute value for the time point.
absolute.name: attDef

interval.title: interval
interval.description:
Specifies the time interval between this time point and the one designated by the
          since attribute. This attribute can only be interpreted meaningfully in conjunction with
          the inttype attribute.
interval.name: attDef

abstype.title: abstype
abstype.description: Specifies the kind of values used in the absolute attribute.
abstype.name: attDef

inttype.title: inttype
inttype.description: Specifies the kind of values used in the interval attribute.
inttype.name: attDef

since.title: since
since.description:
Identifies the reference point for determining the time of the current when element,
          which is obtained by adding the interval to the time of the reference point. The value
          should be the ID of another when element within the same parent element. If the since
          attribute is omitted and the absolute attribute is not specified, then the reference point
          is understood to be the immediately preceding when element.
since.name: attDef

elements.text:
The value in @since should correspond to the @xml:id attribute of a when
                element.

when.title: when
when.description:
Indicates a point in time either absolutely (using the absolute attribute), or relative to
      another when element (using the since, interval and inttype attributes).

model.locrefLike.title: model.locrefLike
model.locrefLike.description: Groups elements used for purposes of location and reference.

ptr.title: pointer
ptr.description:
Defines a traversible pointer to another location, using only attributes to
      describe the destination.

ref.title: reference
ref.description:
Defines a traversible reference to another location. May contain text and
      sub-elements that describe the destination.

macro.anyXML.title: macro.anyXML
macro.anyXML.description: Permits any XML elements except those from the MEI or SVG namespace.

macro.metaLike.page.title: macro.metaLike.page
macro.metaLike.page.description: Groups elements that contain meta-data about a single page.

macro.musicPart.title: macro.musicPart
macro.musicPart.description: Groups elements that may appear as part of the music element.

macro.struc-unstrucContent.title: macro.struc-unstrucContent
macro.struc-unstrucContent.description: Provides a choice between structured and unstructured/mixed content.

macro.titlePart.title: macro.titlePart
macro.titlePart.description: Groups elements that may appear as part of a bibliographic title.

data.BETYPE.title: data.BETYPE
data.BETYPE.description: Datatypes for values in begin, end, abstype and inttype attributes.

func.title: func
func.description: Records the function of an accidental.
func.name: attDef

att.accidental.title: att.accidental
att.accidental.description: Attributes for capturing momentary pitch inflection.

att.annot.log.title: att.annot.log
att.annot.log.description:
Logical domain attributes for annot. Values for the type attribute can be taken from any
      convenient typology of annotation suitable to the work in hand; [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <abbr> tag: {"type":"element","name":"abbr","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"e.g."}]}]], annotation, gloss,
      citation, digression, preliminary, temporary, etc.

artic.title: artic
artic.description:
Encodes the written articulation(s). Articulations are normally encoded in order from
          the note head outward; that is, away from the stem. See additional notes at att.vis.note.
          Only articulations should be encoded in the artic attribute; for example, fingerings
          should be encoded using the [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <gi> tag: {"type":"element","name":"gi","attributes":{"scheme":"MEI"},"elements":[{"type":"text","text":"fing"}]}]] element.
artic.name: attDef

att.articulation.title: att.articulation
att.articulation.description: Attributes for capturing the written signs that describe the method of performance.

target.title: target
target.description: Indicates the next section or movement to be performed.
target.name: attDef

attributes.test: every $i in tokenize(., '\s+') satisfies substring($i,2)=//mei:*[local-name() eq 'section' or local-name() eq 'mdiv']/@xml:id

elements.text:
The value in @target should correspond to the @xml:id attribute of a section or
                mdiv element.

att.audience.title: att.audience
att.audience.description: Attributes that describe the intended audience.

dots.title: dots
dots.description: Records the number of augmentation dots required by a written dotted duration.
dots.name: attDef

elements.text:
An element with a dots attribute must also have a dur
                attribute.

att.augmentDots.title: att.augmentDots
att.augmentDots.description: Attributes that record the number of dots of augmentation.

auth.title: auth
auth.description:
A name or label associated with a controlled vocabulary or other authoritative source
          for this element or its content.
auth.name: attDef

auth.uri.title: auth.uri
auth.uri.description:
A web-accessible location of the controlled vocabulary or other authoritative source
          of identification or definition for this element or its content. This attribute may
          contain a complete URI or a partial URI which is completed by the value of the codedval
          attribute.
auth.uri.name: attDef

att.authorized.title: att.authorized
att.authorized.description: Attributes that describe the source of a controlled value.

form.title: form
form.description: Records the appearance and usually the function of the bar line.
form.name: attDef

bar.len.title: bar.len
bar.len.description:
States the length of bar lines in virtual units. The value must be greater than 0 and
          is typically equal to 2 times (the number of staff lines - 1); [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <abbr> tag: {"type":"element","name":"abbr","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"e.g."}]}]], a value of [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <val> tag: {"type":"element","name":"val","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"8"}]}]] for a
          5-line staff.
bar.len.name: attDef

bar.place.title: bar.place
bar.place.description:
Denotes the staff location of bar lines, if the length is non-standard; that is, not
          equal to 2 times (the number of staff lines - 1).
bar.place.name: attDef

att.barring.title: att.barring
att.barring.description: Attributes that capture the placement of bar lines.

xml:base.title: xml:base
xml:base.description:
Provides a base URI reference with which applications can resolve relative URI
          references into absolute URI references.
xml:base.name: attDef

att.basic.title: att.basic
att.basic.description: Attributes that form the basis of the att.common class.

analog.title: analog
analog.description:
Contains a reference to a field or element in another descriptive encoding system to
          which this MEI element is comparable.
analog.name: attDef

calendar.title: calendar
calendar.description:
Indicates the calendar system to which a date belongs, for example, Gregorian, Julian,
          Roman, Mosaic, Revolutionary, Islamic, etc.
calendar.name: attDef

att.calendared.title: att.calendared
att.calendared.description: Attributes that indicate the calendar system of a date or other datable element.

codedval.title: codedval
codedval.description:
A value that represents or identifies other data. Often, it is a primary key in the
          database or a unique value in the coded list identified by the [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <att> tag: {"type":"element","name":"att","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"auth"}]}]] or
          [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <att> tag: {"type":"element","name":"att","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"auth.uri"}]}]] attributes.
codedval.name: attDef

att.canonical.title: att.canonical
att.canonical.description:
Attributes that can be used to associate a representation such as a name or title with
      canonical information about the object being named or referenced.

att.chord.log.title: att.chord.log
att.chord.log.description:
Logical domain attributes for chord. The artic, dots, and dur attributes encode the
      written articulations, augmentation dots, and duration values. The beam, fermata, lv, slur,
      syl, tie, and tuplet attributes may be used to indicate the attachment of these things to this
      chord. If visual information about these things needs to be recorded, then either the elements
      corresponding to these attributes or the attributes available in the att.vis.chord class
      should be employed.

class.title: class
class.description:
Contains one or more URIs which denote classification terms that apply to the entity
          bearing this attribute.
class.name: attDef

attributes.test: every $i in tokenize(., '\s+') satisfies substring($i,2)=//mei:category/@xml:id or matches($i, '^([a-z]+://|\.{1,2}/)')

elements.text:
The value in @class must either correspond to the @xml:id attribute of a category
                element or be an external URL.

att.classed.title: att.classed
att.classed.description: Attributes which can be used to classify features.

cautionary.title: cautionary
cautionary.description:
Records the function of the clef. A "cautionary" clef does not change the following
          pitches.
cautionary.name: attDef

clef.shape.title: clef.shape
clef.shape.description: Encodes a value for the clef symbol.
clef.shape.name: attDef

clef.line.title: clef.line
clef.line.description:
Contains a default value for the position of the clef. The value must be in the range
          between 1 and the number of lines on the staff. The numbering of lines starts with the
          lowest line of the staff.
clef.line.name: attDef

clef.dis.title: clef.dis
clef.dis.description: Records the amount of octave displacement to be applied to the clef.
clef.dis.name: attDef

clef.dis.place.title: clef.dis.place
clef.dis.place.description: Records the direction of octave displacement to be applied to the clef.
clef.dis.place.name: attDef

att.cleffing.log.title: att.cleffing.log
att.cleffing.log.description:
Used by staffDef and scoreDef to provide default values for attributes in the logical
      domain related to clefs.

att.clefShape.title: att.clefShape
att.clefShape.description: Attributes that record the shape of a clef.

color.title: color
color.description:
Used to indicate visual appearance. Do not confuse this with the musical term 'color'
          as used in pre-CMN notation.
color.name: attDef

colored.title: colored
colored.description:
Indicates this feature is 'colored'; that is, it is a participant in a change in
          rhythmic values. In mensural notation, coloration is indicated by colored notes (red,
          black, etc.) where void notes would otherwise occur. In CMN, coloration is indicated by an
          inverse color; that is, the note head is void when it would otherwise be filled and vice
          versa.
colored.name: attDef

att.contemporary.title: att.contemporary
att.contemporary.description: Attributes specifying whether a feature is contemporary or historical.

att.controlEvent.title: att.controlEvent
att.controlEvent.description:
Attributes shared by events which rely on other events for their existence. For example, a
      slur/phrase marking must be drawn between or over a group of notes. The slur is therefore a
      control event.

lrx.title: lrx
lrx.description: Indicates the lower-right corner x coordinate.
lrx.name: attDef

lry.title: lry
lry.description: Indicates the lower-right corner y coordinate.
lry.name: attDef

rotate.title: rotate
rotate.description:
Indicates the amount by which the contents of this element have been rotated clockwise or, if applicable, how the orientation of
          the element self should be interpreted, with respect to the normal orientation of the parent surface.
          The orientation is expressed in arc degrees.
rotate.name: attDef

att.coordinated.title: att.coordinated
att.coordinated.description:
This attribute class records the position of a feature within a two-dimensional coordinate
      system.

ulx.title: ulx
ulx.description: Indicates the upper-left corner x coordinate.
ulx.name: attDef

uly.title: uly
uly.description: Indicates the upper-left corner y coordinate.
uly.name: attDef

att.coordinated.ul.title: att.coordinated.ul
att.coordinated.ul.description:
This attribute class records the upper left position of a feature within a two-dimensional coordinate
      system.

bezier.title: bezier
bezier.description:
Records the placement of Bezier control points as a series of pairs of space-separated
          values; [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <abbr> tag: {"type":"element","name":"abbr","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"e.g."}]}]], [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <val> tag: {"type":"element","name":"val","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"19 45 -32 118."}]}]]
bezier.name: attDef

bulge.title: bulge
bulge.description:
Describes a curve as one or more pairs of values with respect to an imaginary line
          connecting the starting and ending points of the curve. The first value captures a

              element(s) specified in plist or target attribute.

Indicates letter spacing (aka tracking) in analogy to the CSS letter-spacing
          property.

lineheight.title: lineheight

lineheight.name: attDef

vgrp.title: vgrp
vgrp.description: Provides a label for members of a vertically aligned group.
vgrp.name: attDef

att.verticalGroup.title: att.verticalGroup
att.verticalGroup.description: Attributes that record grouping of vertically aligned elements.

visible.title: visible
visible.description:
Indicates if a feature should be rendered when the notation is presented graphically
          or sounded when it is presented in an aural form.
visible.name: attDef

att.visibility.title: att.visibility
att.visibility.description: Attributes describing whether a feature should be displayed.

att.visualOffset.title: att.visualOffset
att.visualOffset.description:
Visual offset attributes. Some items may have their location recorded in terms of offsets
      from their programmatically-determined location. The ho attribute records the horizontal
      offset while vo records the vertical. The to attribute holds a timestamp offset, the most
      common use of which is as an alternative to the ho attribute.

ho.title: ho
ho.description:
Records a horizontal adjustment to a feature’s programmatically-determined location in
          terms of staff interline distance; that is, in units of 1/2 the distance between adjacent
          staff lines.
ho.name: attDef

to.title: to
to.description:
Records a timestamp adjustment of a feature’s programmatically-determined location in
          terms of musical time; that is, beats.
to.name: attDef

att.visualOffset.to.title: att.visualOffset.to
att.visualOffset.to.description: Horizontal offset attributes specified in terms of time.

vo.title: vo
vo.description:
Records the vertical adjustment of a feature’s programmatically-determined location in
          terms of staff interline distance; that is, in units of 1/2 the distance between adjacent
          staff lines.
vo.name: attDef

att.visualOffset2.title: att.visualOffset2
att.visualOffset2.description:
Visual offset attributes. Some items may have their location recorded in terms of pairs of
      offsets from their programmatically-determined location. The startho and endho attributes
      record the horizontal offsets of the start and end points of the item, respectively.
      Similarly, the startvo and endvo attributes record the vertical offsets of the start and end
      points of the item. The startto and endto attributes hold timestamp offsets, the most common
      use of which is as alternatives to the ho attributes.

startho.title: startho
startho.description:
Records the horizontal adjustment of a feature’s programmatically-determined start
          point.
startho.name: attDef

endho.title: endho
endho.description:
Records the horizontal adjustment of a feature’s programmatically-determined end
          point.
endho.name: attDef

att.visualOffset2.ho.title: att.visualOffset2.ho
att.visualOffset2.ho.description: Horizontal offset requiring a pair of attributes.

startto.title: startto
startto.description:
Records a timestamp adjustment of a feature’s programmatically-determined start
          point.
startto.name: attDef

endto.title: endto
endto.description:
Records a timestamp adjustment of a feature’s programmatically-determined end
          point.
endto.name: attDef

att.visualOffset2.to.title: att.visualOffset2.to
att.visualOffset2.to.description:
Horizontal offset attributes requiring a pair of attributes specified in terms of
      time.

startvo.title: startvo
startvo.description:
Records a vertical adjustment of a feature’s programmatically-determined start
          point.
startvo.name: attDef

endvo.title: endvo
endvo.description:
Records a vertical adjustment of a feature’s programmatically-determined end
          point.
endvo.name: attDef

att.visualOffset2.vo.title: att.visualOffset2.vo
att.visualOffset2.vo.description: Vertical offset attributes requiring a pair of attributes.

voltasym.title: voltasym
voltasym.description: Specifies the symbol used to group lyrics.
voltasym.name: attDef

, |, (wide) line without top and bottom curved/horizontal
              segments.

att.voltaGroupingSym.title: att.voltaGroupingSym
att.voltaGroupingSym.description: Attributes that describe the symbol used to group volta elements.

xml:space.title: xml:space
xml:space.description:
Allows one to signal to an application whether an element’s white space is
          "significant". The behavior of xml:space cascades to all descendant elements, but it can
          be turned off locally by setting the xml:space attribute to the value [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <val> tag: {"type":"element","name":"val","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"default"}]}]].
xml:space.name: attDef

elements.text:
Allows the application to handle white space as necessary. Not including an
              xml:space attribute produces the same result as using the default value.

Instructs the application to maintain white space "as-is", suggesting that it
              might have meaning.

width.title: width
width.description: Measurement of the horizontal dimension of an entity.
width.name: attDef

x.title: x
x.description:
Encodes an x coordinate for a feature in an output coordinate system. When it is
          necessary to record the placement of a feature in a facsimile image, use the facs
          attribute.
x.name: attDef

y.title: y
y.description:
Encodes a y coordinate for a feature in an output coordinate system. When it is
          necessary to record the placement of a feature in a facsimile image, use the facs
          attribute.
y.name: attDef

att.xy.title: att.xy
att.xy.description:
Output coordinate attributes. Some elements may have their exact rendered *output*
      coordinates recorded. x and y attributes indicate where to place the rendered output.
      Recording the coordinates of a feature in a facsimile requires the use of the facs
      attribute.

att.xy2.title: att.xy2
att.xy2.description:
Output coordinate attributes. Some elements may need 2 coordinate pairs to record their
      rendered *output* coordinates. The attributes indicate where to place the rendered output.
      Recording the coordinates of a feature in a facsimile requires the use of the facs
      attribute.

model.addressLike.title: model.addressLike
model.addressLike.description: Groups elements used to represent a postal address.

model.biblLike.title: model.biblLike
model.biblLike.description: Groups elements containing a bibliographic description.

model.biblPart.title: model.biblPart
model.biblPart.description: Groups elements that may appear as part of a bibliographic description.

model.captionLike.title: model.captionLike
model.captionLike.description:
Groups elements that contain the text of a caption or other text displayed along with a
      figure.

model.chordPart.title: model.chordPart
model.chordPart.description: Groups elements that may appear as part of the content of a chord element.

model.controlEventLike.title: model.controlEventLike
model.controlEventLike.description:
Groups elements, such as dynamics, ties, phrase marks, pedal marks, etc., which depend
      upon other events, such as notes or rests, for their existence.

model.dimLike.title: model.dimLike
model.dimLike.description:
Groups elements which describe a measurement forming part of the physical dimensions of an
      object.

model.editionLike.title: model.editionLike
model.editionLike.description: Groups elements containing bibliographic edition information.

model.endingLike.title: model.endingLike
model.endingLike.description: Groups elements that represent alternative endings.

model.eventLike.title: model.eventLike
model.eventLike.description: Groups event elements that occur in all notational repertoires.

model.headLike.title: model.headLike
model.headLike.description:
Groups elements used to provide a heading at the start of a text division or other markup
      component.

model.imprintPart.title: model.imprintPart
model.imprintPart.description: Groups elements that may appear as part of a bibliographic imprint.

model.incipLike.title: model.incipLike
model.incipLike.description: Groups elements used to represent a textual or musical incipit.

model.instrDefLike.title: model.instrDefLike
model.instrDefLike.description: Groups elements used to declare a MIDI instrument.

model.keyAccidLike.title: model.keyAccidLike
model.keyAccidLike.description: Groups elements that represent accidentals in a key signature.

model.keySigLike.title: model.keySigLike
model.keySigLike.description: Groups elements that have the same function as a key signature.

model.labelLike.title: model.labelLike
model.labelLike.description: Groups elements used to assign a label to other parts of a document.

model.layerDefLike.title: model.layerDefLike
model.layerDefLike.description: Groups elements that permit declaration of layer properties.

model.layerLike.title: model.layerLike
model.layerLike.description: Groups elements that function as notational layers within a staff.

model.layerPart.title: model.layerPart
model.layerPart.description: Groups notated events that may appear at the layer level in all repertoires.

model.layerPart.mensuralAndNeumes.title: model.layerPart.mensuralAndNeumes
model.layerPart.mensuralAndNeumes.description:
Groups notated events at the layer level that are shared by the mensural and neume
      repertoires.

model.lbLike.title: model.lbLike
model.lbLike.description: Groups elements that function like line beginnings.

model.mdivLike.title: model.mdivLike
model.mdivLike.description: Groups elements used to represent generic structural divisions of music notation.

model.measurementLike.title: model.measurementLike
model.measurementLike.description: Groups elements that represent a measurement.

model.meterSigLike.title: model.meterSigLike
model.meterSigLike.description: Groups elements that represent a meter signature.

model.milestoneLike.music.title: model.milestoneLike.music
model.milestoneLike.music.description: Groups milestone-style elements found in music notation.

model.milestoneLike.text.title: model.milestoneLike.text
model.milestoneLike.text.description: Groups milestone-style elements found in text.

model.noteModifierLike.title: model.noteModifierLike
model.noteModifierLike.description: Groups elements that modify note-like features.

model.numLike.title: model.numLike
model.numLike.description: Groups elements that denote a number or a quantity.

model.paracontentPart.title: model.paracontentPart
model.paracontentPart.description:
Groups elements which may appear as part of the paragraph content model. A paragraph may
      contain inline elements and all other block-level elements except itself.

model.partLike.title: model.partLike
model.partLike.description: Groups elements that represent a separate performer part.

model.partsLike.title: model.partsLike
model.partsLike.description: Groups elements that collect separate performer parts.

model.relationLike.title: model.relationLike
model.relationLike.description: Collects elements that express a relationship.

model.rendLike.title: model.rendLike
model.rendLike.description: Groups elements that mark typographical features.

model.repositoryLike.title: model.repositoryLike
model.repositoryLike.description: Groups elements that denote a corporate entity that holds a bibliographic item.

model.resourceLike.title: model.resourceLike
model.resourceLike.description: Groups non-text components that represent the content of the musical text.

model.respLike.title: model.respLike
model.respLike.description:
Groups elements that are used to indicate intellectual or other significant
      responsibility, for example within a bibliographic citation.

model.respLikePart.title: model.respLikePart
model.respLikePart.description:
Groups elements that delineate particular responsibilities as opposed to the respStmt
      element that provides for generic statements of responsibility.

model.scoreDefLike.title: model.scoreDefLike
model.scoreDefLike.description: Groups elements that provide score meta-information.

model.scoreLike.title: model.scoreLike
model.scoreLike.description: Groups elements that represent a score.

model.scorePart.title: model.scorePart
model.scorePart.description: Groups elements that may appear as part of a score.

model.sectionLike.title: model.sectionLike
model.sectionLike.description: Groups elements that represent a segment of music notation.

model.sectionPart.title: model.sectionPart
model.sectionPart.description: Groups elements that may appear as part of a section.

model.sectionPart.mensuralAndNeumes.title: model.sectionPart.mensuralAndNeumes
model.sectionPart.mensuralAndNeumes.description:
Groups elements that may appear as part of a section in the mensural and neume
      repertoires.

model.staffDefLike.title: model.staffDefLike
model.staffDefLike.description: Groups elements that permit declaration of staff properties.

model.staffDefPart.title: model.staffDefPart
model.staffDefPart.description: Groups elements that may appear in the declaration of staff features.

model.staffGrpLike.title: model.staffGrpLike
model.staffGrpLike.description: Groups elements that permit declaration of staff group properties.

model.staffLike.title: model.staffLike
model.staffLike.description: Groups elements that function like staves.

model.staffPart.title: model.staffPart
model.staffPart.description: Groups elements that are components of a staff.

model.staffPart.mensuralAndNeumes.title: model.staffPart.mensuralAndNeumes
model.staffPart.mensuralAndNeumes.description:
Groups elements that are components of a staff in the mensural and neume
      repertoires.

model.sylLike.title: model.sylLike
model.sylLike.description: Groups elements that contain a lyric syllable.

model.textPhraseLike.title: model.textPhraseLike
model.textPhraseLike.description: Groups textual elements that occur at the level of individual words or phrases.

model.textPhraseLike.limited.title: model.textPhraseLike.limited
model.textPhraseLike.limited.description:
Groups textual elements that occur at the level of individual words or phrases. This class
      is equivalent to the model.textPhraseLike class without the pb element.

model.titleLike.title: model.titleLike
model.titleLike.description: Groups elements that denote the name of a bibliographic item.

model.titlePagePart.title: model.titlePagePart
model.titlePagePart.description: Groups elements that may appear as part of a title page transcription.

model.tuningPart.title: model.tuningPart
model.tuningPart.description: Groups elements that may appear inside the [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <gi> tag: {"type":"element","name":"gi","attributes":{"scheme":"MEI"},"elements":[{"type":"text","text":"tuning"}]}]] element.

accid.title: accidental
accid.description: Records a temporary alteration to the pitch of a note.

actor.title: actor
actor.description: Name of an actor appearing within a cast list.

address.title: address
address.description:
Contains a postal address, for example of a publisher, an organization, or an
      individual.

addrLine.title: address line
addrLine.description: Single line of a postal address.

ambitus.title: ambitus
ambitus.description: Range of a voice, instrument or piece.

ambNote.title: ambNote
ambNote.description: Highest or lowest pitch in a score, staff, or layer.

analytic.title: analytic level
analytic.description:
Contains bibliographic elements describing an item ([[ERROR: Cannot process text with <abbr> tag: {"type":"element","name":"abbr","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"e.g."}]}]], an article or
      poem) published within a monograph or journal and not as an independent publication.

annot.title: annotation
annot.description:
Provides a statement explaining the text or indicating the basis for an
      assertion.

arranger.title: arranger
arranger.description:
A person or organization who transcribes a musical composition, usually for a different
      medium from that of the original; in an arrangement the musical substance remains essentially
      unchanged.

artic.title: articulation
artic.description: An indication of how to play a note or chord.

author.title: author
author.description:
The name of the creator of the intellectual content of a non-musical, literary
      work.

barLine.title: barLine
barLine.description:
Vertical line drawn through one or more staves that divides musical notation into metrical
      units.

bibl.title: bibliographic reference
bibl.description:
Provides a loosely-structured bibliographic citation in which
      the sub-components may or may not be explicitly marked.

biblScope.title: scope of citation
biblScope.description:
Defines the scope of a bibliographic reference, for example as a
      list of page numbers, or a named subdivision of a larger work.

biblStruct.title: structured bibliographic citation
biblStruct.description:
Contains a bibliographic citation in which
      bibliographic sub-elements must appear in a specified order.

body.title: body
body.description: Contains the whole of a single musical text, excluding any front or back matter.

caesura.title: caesura
caesura.description:
Break, pause, or interruption in the normal tempo of a composition. Typically indicated by
      "railroad tracks", [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <abbr> tag: {"type":"element","name":"abbr","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"i.e."}]}]], two diagonal slashes.

caption.title: caption
caption.description: A label which accompanies an illustration or a table.

castGrp.title: cast group
castGrp.description: Groups one or more individual castItem elements within a cast list.

castItem.title: castItem
castItem.description:
Contains a single entry within a cast list, describing either a single role or a list of
      non-speaking roles.

castList.title: castList
castList.description: Contains a single cast list or dramatis personae.
