The value of @n should be less than or equal
                to the value of @cols (

cb.title: column beginning
cb.description:
An empty formatting element that forces text to begin in a new
      column.

chord.title: chord
chord.description:
A simultaneous sounding of two or more notes in the same layer *with the same
      duration*.

clef.title: clef
clef.description:
Indication of the exact location of a particular note on the staff and, therefore, the
      other notes as well.

colLayout.title: column layout
colLayout.description:
An empty formatting element that signals the start of columnar
      layout.

composer.title: composer
composer.description: The name of the creator of the intellectual content of a musical work.

role.title: role
role.description: Used to specify the contributor’s function.
role.name: attDef

contributor.title: contributor
contributor.description:
Names of individuals, institutions, or organizations responsible for contributions to the
      intellectual content of a work, where the specialized elements for authors, editors, etc. do
      not suffice or do not apply.

creation.title: creation
creation.description:
Non-bibliographic details of the creation of an intellectual entity, in narrative form,
      such as the date, place, and circumstances of its composition. More detailed information may
      be captured within the history element.

custos.title: custos
custos.description:
Symbol placed at the end of a line of music to indicate the first note of the next line.
      Sometimes called a "direct".

date.title: date
date.description: A string identifying a point in time or the time period between two such points.

dedicatee.title: dedicatee
dedicatee.description: Entity to whom a creative work is formally offered.

depth.title: depth
depth.description: Description of a measurement taken through a three-dimensional object.

desc.title: description
desc.description:
Container for text that briefly describes the feature to which it is
      attached, including its intended usage, purpose, or application as appropriate.

form.title: form
form.description: Aspect of the object being measured.
form.name: attDef

elements.text:
Altitude. Refers to the distance above a given level, commonly mean sea
              level.

Angle. Amount of rotation needed to bring one line or plane into coincidence with
              another.

Dimension taken through an object or body of material, usually downward from an
              upper surface, horizontally inward from an outer surface, or from top to bottom of
              something regarded as one of several layers.

Length of a straight line passing through the center of a circle or sphere and
              meeting the circumference or surface at each end.
Distance to which something has been raised or uplifted above a level,

, a
              hill’s elevation above the surrounding country.

Denotes extent upward (as from foot to head) as well as any measurable distance
              above a given level.
Measure of the greatest dimension of a plane or solid figure.
Half the diameter of a circular, spherical, or cylindrical object.
Projection of a figure or part from the plane on which it is formed.
Extent from side to side; breadth.

dimensions.title: dimensions
dimensions.description: Information about the physical size of an entity; usually includes numerical data.

dir.title: directive
dir.description:
An instruction expressed as a combination of text and symbols, typically above,
      below, or between staves, but not on the staff — that is not encoded elsewhere in more specific
      elements, like [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <gi> tag: {"type":"element","name":"gi","attributes":{"scheme":"MEI"},"elements":[{"type":"text","text":"tempo"}]}]], [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <gi> tag: {"type":"element","name":"gi","attributes":{"scheme":"MEI"},"elements":[{"type":"text","text":"dynam"}]}]]  or [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <gi> tag: {"type":"element","name":"gi","attributes":{"scheme":"MEI"},"elements":[{"type":"text","text":"repeatMark"}]}]].

distributor.title: distributor
distributor.description:
Person or agency, other than a publisher, from which access (including electronic access)
      to a bibliographic entity may be obtained.

type.title: type
type.description:
Characterizes the textual division in some sense, using any convenient classification
          scheme or typology that employs single-token labels.
type.name: attDef

elements.text: A summary of the content of a text as continuous prose.

A formal declaration of acknowledgment by the author in which persons and
              institutions are thanked for their part in the creation of a text.

An ancillary self-contained section of a work, often providing additional but in
              some sense extra-canonical text.

A statement appearing at the end of a book describing the conditions of its
              physical production.

A table of contents, specifying the structure of a work and listing its
              constituents. The list element should be used to mark its structure.

A formal offering or dedication of a text to one or more persons or institutions
              by the author.
A pictorial frontispiece, possibly including some text.
A list of terms associated with definition texts (‘glosses’).

A page containing only the title of a book — as opposed to the title page, which
              also lists subtitle, author, imprint and similar data.
Any form of index to the work.
A section in which annotations on the text are gathered together.

A foreword or preface addressed to the reader in which the author or publisher
              explains the content, purpose, or origin of the text.

div.title: division
div.description:
Major structural division of text, such as a preface, chapter or
      section.

dynam.title: dynamic
dynam.description: Indication of the volume of a note, phrase, or section of music.

edition.title: edition designation
edition.description:
A word or text phrase that indicates a difference in either
      content or form between the item being described and a related item previously issued by the
      same publisher/distributor ([[ERROR: Cannot process text with <abbr> tag: {"type":"element","name":"abbr","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"e.g."}]}]], 2nd edition, version 2.0, etc.), or simultaneously issued by
      either the same publisher/distributor or another publisher/distributor ([[ERROR: Cannot process text with <abbr> tag: {"type":"element","name":"abbr","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"e.g."}]}]], large print
      edition, British edition, etc.).

editor.title: editor
editor.description:
The name of the individual(s), institution(s) or organization(s) acting in an editorial
      capacity.

ending.title: ending
ending.description:
Alternative ending for a repeated passage of music; [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <abbr> tag: {"type":"element","name":"abbr","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"i.e."}]}]], prima volta, seconda volta,
      etc.

eventList.title: eventList
eventList.description: Contains historical information given as a sequence of significant past events.

expansion.title: expansion
expansion.description:
Indicates how a section may be programmatically expanded into its 'through-composed'
      form.

extent.title: extent
extent.description:
Used to express size in terms other than physical dimensions, such as number of pages,
      records, bytes, physical components, etc.

extData.title: extended data
extData.description: Provides a container element for non-MEI data formats.

funder.title: funder
funder.description:
Names of individuals, institutions, or organizations responsible for funding. Funders
      provide financial support for a project; they are distinct from sponsors, who provide
      intellectual support and authority.

genre.title: genre
genre.description:
Term or terms that designate a category characterizing a particular style, form, or
      content.

group.title: group
group.description:
Contains a composite musical text, grouping together a sequence of distinct musical texts
      (or groups of such musical texts) which are regarded as a unit for some purpose, for example,
      the collected works of a composer.

grpSym.title: group symbol
grpSym.description:
A brace or bracket used to group two or more staves of a score or
      part.

head.title: heading
head.description:
Contains any heading, for example, the title of a section of text, or the
      heading of a list.

height.title: height
height.description: Description of the vertical size of an object.

identifier.title: identifier
identifier.description: An alpha-numeric string that establishes the identity of the described material.

imprint.title: imprint
imprint.description: Information relating to the publication or distribution of a bibliographic item.

incip.title: incipit
incip.description: The opening music and/or words of a musical or textual work.

form.title: form
form.description:
Specifies whether enharmonic (written) values or implicit ("perform-able") values are
          allowed.
form.name: attDef

elements.text: Only performed values (sharp, flat, natural) allowed.

label.title: label
label.description:
A container for document text that identifies the feature to which it is attached. For a
      "tool tip" or other generated label, use the [[ERROR: Cannot process text with <att> tag: {"type":"element","name":"att","elements":[{"type":"text","text":"label"}]}]] attribute.

labelAbbr.title: labelAbbr
labelAbbr.description: A label on the pages following the first.

layer.title: layer
layer.description: An independent stream of events on a staff.

lb.title: line beginning
lb.description:
An empty formatting element that forces text to begin on a new
      line.

lg.title: line group

librettist.title: librettist
librettist.description: Person or organization who is a writer of the text of an opera, oratorio, etc.

lyricist.title: lyricist
lyricist.description: Person or organization who is a writer of the text of a song.

mdiv.title: musical division
mdiv.description: Contains a subdivision of the body of a musical text.

mei.title: mei
mei.description:
Contains a single MEI-conformant document, consisting of an MEI header and a musical text,
      either in isolation or as part of an meiCorpus element.

monogr.title: monograph level
monogr.description:
Contains bibliographic elements describing an item, for example, a
      published book or journal, score, recording, or an unpublished manuscript.

music.title: music
music.description:
Contains a single musical text of any kind, whether unitary or composite, for example, an
      etude, opera, song cycle, symphony, or anthology of piano solos.

type.title: type
type.description:
Characterizes the name in some sense, using any convenient classification scheme or
          typology that employs single-token labels.
type.name: attDef

elements.text: Name of a process or software application.
Name of a period of time.

value.title: value
value.description:
Numeric value capturing a measurement or count. Can only be interpreted in combination
          with the unit attribute.
value.name: attDef

ornam.title: ornam
ornam.description: An element indicating an ornament that is not a mordent, turn, or trill.

p.title: paragraph
p.description: One or more text phrases that form a logical prose passage.

pad.title: padding
pad.description: An indication of extra visual space between notational elements.

part.title: part
part.description:
An alternative visual rendition of the score from the point of view of a particular
      performer (or group of performers).

parts.title: parts
parts.description: Provides a container for performers' parts.

pb.title: page beginning
pb.description:
An empty formatting element that forces text to begin on a new
      page.

pgDesc.title: page description
pgDesc.description:
Contains a brief prose description of the appearance or description
      of the content of a physical page.

phrase.title: phrase
phrase.description: Indication of 1) a "unified melodic idea" or 2) performance technique.

physLoc.title: physical location
physLoc.description:
Groups information about the current physical location of a

att.hairpin.vis.description:
Visual domain attributes. The startho and startvo attributes record the horizontal and
      vertical offsets of the left end, endho and endvo record the horizontal and vertical offsets
      of the right end, and the opening attribute records the width of the opening in staff
      inter-line units. The x and y attributes give the absolute coordinates of the left end point,
      and x2 and y2 the right end point, of an imaginary line that defines the length of the hairpin
      and horizontally bifurcates it. The so-called "pitch" of hairpin may be controlled by use of
      the startho, endho, startvo, and endvo attributes, while the placement of the entire rendered
      mark may be controlled by use of the ho and vo attributes.
